product_name: The Overlook - Natural Bamboo/Natural Canvas / Yes
description: The Overlook takes everything cats love about the smaller Grotto and gives it more room to breathe. Across three distinct privacy levels it suits a multi-cat home, with several ways in and out of every resting area so no cat gets cornered. A ladder helps smaller cats reach the middle level, and the hammocks are spaced to leave gaps on either side for interactive play between cats at different heights. Bamboo panels carry the signature triangle cutouts for sightlines and hunting practice, and a Window Panel upgrade widens the view on the second level. Down low is a cozy, private space with peek-through windows. The middle adds a solid bamboo shelf topped with a removable plush faux fur pad and two walls for moderate cover. Up top, an extra-large heavyweight canvas hammock delivers the big panoramic seat, a 16 inch jump up with an easy drop back to the floor. It is made from solid sustainable bamboo, metal poles, heavyweight canvas, and premium plush faux fur, and the soft parts come off for washing and swap out when they wear.

product_name: Horizontal Scratching Post - English Chestnut Bamboo / 2-Tier / Double
description: Mount the pole horizontally and it changes the whole game. Now your cat gets a long sisal surface to stretch along and rake, and because it sits up the wall it nudges them to jump for it, which is exercise dressed up as play. Your furniture gets a break in the bargain. The poles fit on the front or the back of the mounting plank, which lets you build doubled-up posts and mix diagonal, vertical, and horizontal runs into one interlocking climb. That variety is a gift in a multi-cat home. Anchor one plank into a stud and use the drywall anchors for the second, though for the steadiest result and easy expansion later, aim to hit studs with both.

product_name: The Crossroads - English Chestnut Bamboo/Natural Canvas / 16"
description: The Crossroads is a scratcher's dream. The X-shaped centerpiece hands cats a big, inviting climbing frame where they can jump, scale, and rake their way to the top, and the poles branch into several routes so play stretches out for hours. When the energy runs down, there is a scratcher bed high on the wall for a private nap. Getting up starts at the angled scratcher, which works as both an inclined clawing surface and a ramp, an easy on-ramp for bigger cats or nervous climbers, and a gentle gatekeeper that keeps non-cat roommates out of the clubhouse. From there cats branch off, dropping onto a canvas hammock for the afternoon or pushing up the horizontal scratcher to keep exploring. A second nook up top adds a semi-enclosed cubby with a canvas side wall and a shelf overhead. It is made for both 16 and 24 inch stud spacing. It suits energetic cats and loungers alike, and it plays well with feather toys and ribbon, which is why you will spot it in cat cafes. Big cats and kittens both take to it.

product_name: The Grotto - English Chestnut Bamboo/Natural Canvas
description: The Grotto proves small does not mean simple. In a tidy footprint it packs a range of spaces, each with a different degree of seclusion, so a bold cat and a shy one can share it and both feel at home. There is somewhere to sleep, scratch, hunt, and play across its levels. The bamboo panels are cut with triangle windows that sharpen the view and invite ambush play and paw-swipes between cats. Down low sits an extra-large hammock near the ground, ideal for a kitten or a timid cat, framed by canvas into a private cubby. The middle level mirrors that with a snug cubby open above and below for games, and the top offers an extra-large hammock with ledges to lean on and lookouts on every side.

product_name: Cat Cubby for Wall - English Chestnut Bamboo / Slotted
description: This adds a perch to either side of the standard cubby, which does two things at once. It gives your cat more choices, curl up out of sight behind the fabric when the house is busy, or step out onto a ledge for the full panorama. Go blank or brick for a closed-off, private feel, pick the porthole or baby dragon cutouts for a playful lookout, or choose the slotted panel for a semi-enclosed spot that stays breezy. It is built for 16 inch stud spacing and installs without fuss.

description: When you are short on horizontal wall, the Deluxe Fort goes vertical. Your cat enters up the ramp at the bottom, climbs through the escape hatch in the middle, or drops in from above by way of the hammocks. It stacks a lot of activity into a small footprint. Add the scratching pole and you fold healthy climbing and clawing into the same structure. It fits a home of one to three cats and is a smart pick where territory is a concern, since a leaf shelf on the pole adds extra pathways and perches so no cat gets cornered. It comes in versions for 16 and 24 inch stud spacing.

product_name: Hanging Cat Bed Hammock - English Chestnut Bamboo / Natural Canvas / 18"
description: The hammock is the piece the whole range circles back to. On its own it is a swinging bed your cat can sink into, and strung together with others it becomes a soft path across the wall. Set up off the floor, it also doubles as a bolthole, a spot to duck away from a dog, a toddler, or a bossier housemate, which does wonders for a nervous cat. It is built to grow with you. The modular hardware ties into bridges, shelves, and scratching poles, and you can bolt on a feeder or planter attachment down the line. Each kit ships with a pair of bamboo mounting planks, your choice of heavyweight cotton canvas or clear vinyl, and all the hardware. Pick 18 or 34 inch for 16 inch studs, or the 26 inch for 24 inch spacing.

product_name: The Juggernaut - English Chestnut Bamboo/Natural Canvas / Planter Shelves / Leaf Shelf
description: The Juggernaut is the flagship, and it shows. It stacks in multiple hammocks, a sisal scratching pole, floating scratching posts, a bridge across the middle, and a planter shelf for a bit of green. There is enough room and enough different routes that a crowd of cats, or a couple of very large ones, can spread out and never feel boxed in. Movement is the whole point. Cats perch, prowl, and pick their way through the features, and for a gentler climb the escape hatch and roped bridge offer an easier line up. It is built for 16 inch spacing and can be special-ordered for 24 inch, so reach out if your studs differ. The planter shelf ships ready for cat-safe greenery like spider plant, lemon button fern, catnip, cat grass, variegated wax plant, lilyturf, or Boston fern. Plants are not included.

It keeps the emphasis on activity, with plenty of restful spots worked in, and a 50 inch bridge ties the scratching pole to the rest of the structure. A leaf shelf sits partway up the scratching pole, and it does more than add a perch, it means your cat can move through the whole condo without hitting a dead end. Open routing like that keeps cats from feeling cornered and keeps the peace when there is more than one of them. It comes in versions for 16 and 24 inch stud spacing.

product_name: Floating Cat Step
description: This is a scratcher and a foothold in one. Wrapped in tough natural sisal, it stands up to real clawing without the shedding and crumbling you get from cardboard, and mounted in a line these steps become a climbing route up the wall. The sisal is glued down the full length of the post, so it will not sag or unravel after a season of heavy use. It was made with renters in mind. The step goes into studs but will also take drywall, brick, or concrete, and it hangs on two standard number 8 screws, the same size you would use for a picture. A foam backing protects your paint, and pulling it off later leaves only two small holes to patch. As the original floating sisal post, it has had over a decade of refinement behind it, with a steel bracket rated to hold up to 70 pounds per post.
category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Cat Supplies > Cat Furniture > Cat Scratchers & Scratching Posts

product_name: Catnip Buds
description: These are the buds, not the dusty leaf and stem you usually get. Grown and picked by hand in Washington and cut late when the essential oils peak, they land far more potent than the bagged stuff. Break a bud off the stem, crush it between your fingers to wake up the aroma, and hand it over. It is a treat with no downside, a hit of stimulation and zero calories, ideal right before a toy session to get a lazy cat off the couch. The buds are non-GMO and organically grown, and each order comes with a half ounce.
category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Cat Supplies > Cat Treats

product_name: The Plateau - English Chestnut Bamboo/Charcoal Gray Canvas
description: The Plateau covers all the scratching bases. product_name: Catnip Spray for Cats
description: Made from the essential oils pressed out of catnip buds, this spray delivers the good part without the mess. Because it is concentrated oil rather than dried extract, it tends to land harder than sprinkling loose catnip, and it soaks in where you want it. A quick mist revives a toy that has lost its charm or helps a wary cat warm up to a new canvas hammock. It earns its keep as a training aid too. Spritz a sisal pole or scratcher, wave a toy over it, and you have a simple way to steer claws off the couch and onto the right surface. The formula is nothing but pure catnip essential oil and distilled water, and a one ounce bottle gives you up to 200 sprays.
category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Cat Supplies > Cat Treats

product_name: The Catacombs - English Chestnut Bamboo/Natural Canvas / 16"
description: The Catacombs is built around movement. Leaf shelves branch off the scratching pole to open up route after route through the condo, which is exactly what a multi-cat home needs, more ways through means fewer dead ends and fewer chances for one cat to trap another. And the leaf shelves are not fixed, you can flip them to change their look and spin them around the pole to widen the condo or carve out fresh paths to explore.

Leaf shelves branch off the scratching pole to open up route after route through the condo, which is exactly what a multi-cat home needs, more ways through means fewer dead ends and fewer chances for one cat to trap another. And the leaf shelves are not fixed, you can flip them to change their look and spin them around the pole to widen the condo or carve out fresh paths to explore.

product_name: The Raceway - English Chestnut Bamboo/Natural Canvas
description: The Raceway plays two ways. It links a pair of roomy 34 inch hammocks with a diagonal fabric run and a ladder for grip, so an energetic cat can sprint the track from one end to the other, then a tired one can melt into either hammock. It works solo or bolts onto another condo to widen the play area. We hung ours about fourteen inches above the sofa, using the lower hammock as the starting line and letting the cats climb to the upper level for the best nap in the house. It also makes a tidy on-ramp up the wall to connect with other pieces. Best for a home of one or two cats, built for 16 inch stud spacing.

product_name: The Double Decker - English Chestnut Bamboo/Natural Canvas
description: The Double Decker stacks two beds into one piece. Three panels of heavyweight canvas make up a 34 inch hammock on the bottom and an 18 inch hammock up top, with a vertical fabric wall between them that walls off a private nook for a cat who wants to be left alone. The hop from one level to the next is short and easy. Mount it low as an entry point onto the cat wall, or set it higher above the sofa to build up your layout, either way it creates a nice staircase effect. It is a good fit for a smaller household of one or two cats and is built for 16 inch stud spacing.

product_name: Coco Cat Basket - Beige
description: Coco starts with cotton rope, hand-woven into a rounded basket with the kind of even, tactile finish that only comes from patient work. The rope carries an Oeko-Tex certification, so what your cat curls up against has been checked for the stuff you don't want near them. It feels sturdy under the paw and looks considered on the floor. Down at the base sits a soft cushion, and that's really the whole trick. Cats want somewhere that holds a bit of warmth and gives a little when they settle. The pillow does that job while the woven walls give them a sense of edges to lean into. Pick from Beige, Green, Light Brown, or Anthracite depending on what your room is already doing.
category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Cat Supplies > Cat Beds

product_name: Lulu Cat Bed - Anthracite
description: Lulu pairs a solid ash frame with a quilted fabric pillow, and the restraint is the point. The wood is left clean and simple, the sort of minimalist line that sits happily next to whatever else you own. Nothing shouts. It just holds its shape and does the job. The pillow is where a cat commits. Quilted, soft, and generous enough to sink into, it turns the frame into an actual resting place rather than a display piece. Fabric colors run from Light Grey and Honey through Light Anthracite to Raspberry, so you can play it quiet or add a small jolt of color.

product_name: Kikko Table - Anthracite
description: Kikko is a coffee or side table first, drawn in a clean Scandinavian line, then quietly given a second life. Slender metal elements break up the wood and keep it from feeling heavy. On top you set down a mug or a book like you would with any table. Underneath is where the cat business happens. A quilted fabric hammock hangs below the tabletop, sized so a cat can actually settle in and stay a while rather than perch and give up. It's a nice bit of engineering hidden in plain sight. Hammock colors come in Grey, Raspberry, Light Anthracite, and Honey.

product_name: Tollo Toy - Anthracite
description: Tollo is put together by hand from a natural leather strap and wooden elements, finished with two faux fur balls at the business end. The materials matter here, real leather and wood feel and wear differently from the plastic clutter most cat toys are made of, and they look like something you'd leave on the shelf between play sessions. The fur balls do the persuading. Cats bat, chase, and stalk them, and the leather strap gives you or the toy enough movement to keep the hunt interesting. Colors come in Cappuccino, Light Brown, and Silver.
category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Cat Supplies > Cat Toys

product_name: Musse Toy - Silver
description: Musse is a wand-style teaser made by hand from a leather strap and wooden elements, dressed with natural bird feathers and a bit of faux fur. That mix is the point. Feathers flutter and dart in a way cats read as prey, and the fur adds a texture worth pouncing on, so the toy keeps working long after the novelty of a plainer one wears off. You supply the movement, the toy supplies the instinct. Flick it low along the floor or arc it overhead and a cat locks on. It comes in Silver and Brown.

description: Apawtment gives a cat somewhere to retreat without shutting them in a box. The frame is European birch plywood veneered in solid ash and finished with oil and wax, so it reads as a piece of furniture rather than pet gear, and the opening stays generous enough that a cat can keep one eye on the room. Inside there is a soft plush rug that takes the edge off a wooden floor, and a blackboard on the front for a name. It is light enough to move between rooms as the sun does.

product_name: Chubby Oak Cat Scratcher
description: Most posts fail for one reason: they move. The Chubby Oak answers that with mass. It weighs a little over 13 kilos on a wide oak base, so a cat can throw their whole body at it without the thing skidding across the floor or rocking against the wall. The post is short by design, closer to the ground and wrapped in thick 12mm sisal, which suits cats that scratch horizontally or lean into it low. Levelling feet take up the slack on uneven floors.
category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Cat Supplies > Cat Furniture

product_name: English Oak and Sisal Rope Cat Scratcher
description: This one is cut from one substantial piece of Devon oak rather than assembled from boards, so the grain runs continuously and the live edge stays as the tree left it. The medium oil finish warms the tone without hiding anything. At just over 13 kilos on a broad base it behaves like furniture rather than pet gear, and the 12mm sisal rope is wound tight enough to take years of daily use.
category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Cat Supplies > Cat Furniture

product_name: Oak Cat Scratcher with Resin Inlay
description: Oak splits as it seasons. Rather than hide it, this piece fills those seams with black epoxy so they read as deliberate lines through the grain. The base is a full 5cm thick and sits on five adjustable legs. At 81cm it is tall enough for a big cat to stretch out fully, which is the whole point of a vertical post and the thing most short ones get wrong.
category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Cat Supplies > Cat Furniture

product_name: Handmade Oak Cat Scratcher
description: Not every home has room for a full tower. category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Cat Supplies > Cat Furniture

product_name: Oak Cat Scratcher with Resin Slice

product_name: Weenect XS Cat GPS Tracker - Tracker only / Black
description: A cat who slips outside can be halfway down the block before you notice. The Weenect XS puts their live location on your phone, refreshed as often as every second, so you can see where they actually go and call them home with a sound and a light when it is time to come in. It is the smallest real GPS tracker made for cats, light enough at 27 grams that most settle into it within a day. There is no range limit. A built-in SIM keeps it connected across the country and in more than 170 others, and you can draw safe zones on the map that ping you the moment your cat leaves one. The case is waterproof, the collar releases if it ever snags, and a full charge lasts up to a week in power-saving mode. Because the tracker sends its position over the mobile network, it runs on a subscription, the same way a phone does. Pick the tracker on its own and set up a plan once it arrives, or take the version with a full year included so it is ready the day you open the box. Either way you get the tracker, the elastic cat collar, a silicone case that clips to any collar or harness, and the charging cable.

category: Animals & Pet Supplies > Pet Supplies > Pet Beds
